items.title: RWF instead of RF
items.body: Amounts now start with the currency code, such as RWF 5,000, the same way packages and bookings already do. This applies wherever prices, balances and checkout totals are shown.

items.title: Packages are easier to scan and manage
items.body: Prices now show with their currency code, such as RWF 100,000, and counts read correctly, like 1 video. One New package button and an All, Indoor, Outdoor filter replace the three action cards.

items.title: Deleting a package is safer
items.body: Delete now lives in the more menu, names the package before it goes, and shows a clear message with Try again if it fails, instead of hiding the package from your list.

items.title: A package from a brochure never gets a made-up price
items.body: If a brochure has no price for a package, it now shows Price needed and cannot be published until you enter one. A failed publish also stops safely and shows Try again, instead of repeating itself.

items.title: The logo now reads as one mark
items.body: The Connekyt symbol and name in the top bar sit close together, so they look like a single logo instead of two separate pieces.

releases.title: Send to your TV in one tap

items.title: Watch on TV goes straight to your TV
items.body: If you have one TV, or used one before, tapping the TV icon on a live stream sends it there right away. TVs that are on now show as On.

releases.title: Photographers near you, using your location

items.title: The map follows where you are
items.body: When you allow it, the Photographers map centres on your phone's location, like the website does. Clients and photographers only ever see a general area, never your exact position.
